name: Regular Agent Skill development
description: Create a concise, reusable Agent Skill with deterministic resources, standard metadata, structural validation, and realistic forward testing.

stages.title: Define triggers and concrete usage
stages.summary: Turn the requested capability into explicit examples, boundaries, and success criteria.
stages.acceptanceGate: Another agent can tell when the Skill should and should not trigger.

capabilities.label: Agent Skill requirements and trigger design
acceptanceCriteria: Concrete prompts and boundaries are defined

stages.title: Design reusable Skill resources
stages.summary: Choose the minimum scripts, references, and assets that make repeated execution reliable.
stages.acceptanceGate: Every bundled file directly supports a recurring task and detailed context is loaded only when needed.

capabilities.label: Skill resource architecture and progressive disclosure
acceptanceCriteria: The SKILL.md stays concise and reusable logic is bundled

stages.title: Initialize the standard Skill structure
stages.summary: Create the named directory, SKILL.md, and Agent UI metadata with the standard generator.
stages.acceptanceGate: The directory name, frontmatter name, description, and default prompt satisfy the Agent Skill conventions.

capabilities.label: Agent Skill scaffolding and metadata generation
acceptanceCriteria: The official initializer creates the structure

stages.title: Implement instructions and resources
stages.summary: Write imperative instructions and test every deterministic script on representative inputs.
stages.acceptanceGate: The Skill can perform its core task without hidden project context or placeholder files.

stages.title: Validate structure and behavior
stages.summary: Run the standard validator, syntax checks, focused tests, and the project's relevant regression suite.
stages.acceptanceGate: Structural checks and representative core paths pass with reproducible commands.

capabilities.label: Agent Skill validation and quality assurance
acceptanceCriteria: Validation commands and results are recorded

stages.title: Forward-test and iterate
stages.summary: Use a fresh regular Agent context on a realistic request, inspect raw artifacts, fix transferable failures, and retest.
stages.acceptanceGate: A fresh Agent can complete the representative task from the Skill and task-local context alone.

capabilities.label: Independent Agent Skill forward testing
acceptanceCriteria: The test does not leak expected answers or hidden context
